C-44.Name: App Store build: enable the macOS Share button
C-44.Summary: The App Store build hides the title-bar Share button only because m048 reports share=false there; mt_share_file (m032, NSSharingServicePicker on a file the user opened) is sandbox-safe. Report share=true on macOS in the app-store build too. The m045 live server stays OFF in the app-store build (App Review comment; user decision 2026-10-15).

Problem.Description: User 2026-10-15: «поделиться включаем»; «лайв выключаем … он должен оставаться по гейту выключенным».

Goals.R-1: m048 mt_build_mode: share = cfg!(target_os = "macos") in the app-store variant as in desktop.
Goals.R-2: Unit guard: the app-store variant advertises share on macOS and still never advertises pandoc, screenshot or the default-handler; the live server stays compiled out.

Constraints.Constraint: No new entitlements; the live server gate in main.rs is untouched.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Enabling the live server in the app-store build.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The App Store build shows the Share button on macOS and the share sheet opens for the current file.

C-44.VerificationIntent: cargo test with and without --features app-store; live check in the next MAS build.
